notes.note: Rewrote the PR source FIFO paragraph against ci.yml: statics now use three buckets by the PR number's last digit (0, 2, 4, 6 even; 1, 3, 5 odd; 7, 8, 9 third), matching the fast-checks-statics group and the actionlint-gate pin; added the transition note (odd/even names kept, so the repository ceiling stays three and only PRs ending 7, 8 or 9 can briefly hold an old bucket and third); PR computation slot total is now nine (five shard, three statics, one release-bot). Shard, release-bot and supersession prose unchanged and still matches ci.yml.

Updated the capacity paragraph: PR computation is nine slots (five shard, three statics, one release-bot), so 11 merge-group jobs + 4 Free qualification + 9 = 24; recorded the 2026-11-15 statics wait measurement (70-minute wait, 13 of 20 runners busy) and the sampled ~13-minute statics duration (median 12.7 over 13 successful PR statics jobs) giving about fourteen pushes an hour; the rollback lever on rising merge-group runner wait is now to return statics to two parity slots first, then lower the shard slot count.
